events.title: New loom arrives
events.quote: the new loom arrived on the 9th of March

events.title: Carders' strike begins
events.quote: The strike began on Monday, 25 July 1887, when the carders walked out over the new pay rates

events.title: Hale meets the strikers
events.quote: Mr. Hale finally met the carders on Thursday 28 July

events.title: Mill destroyed by fire
events.quote: The mill burned on the night of 12 November 1888

events.title: Rebuilding planned
events.quote: Father means to rebuild in the spring
